analysis.analysis_para2: The S&P 500 is trading down 0.52% at 7570.53, while the Nasdaq 100 shows relative resilience, down 0.24% at 30587.39. Despite the day's weakness, market breadth remains constructive, with 54.5% of stocks above their 50-day moving average and 62.6% above their 200-day moving average. Focus remains on high-Relative Strength leaders, as they are likely to hold up best and offer cleaner entry points on shallow pullbacks in a consolidating market.
